reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. I confirmed the two facts: the Kestrel rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines is at Dock 31, and Linnea Brevik is the main contact for the Osprey rollout at Brackenwater Freight Co.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. I also didn't save these facts to persistent memory. They're on record in the channel, where #north-team members can see them, and keeping them in memory could carry them into other members' conversations.
